quest.name: Wolves at the Well
quest.description: Wolves keep the villagers away from the old well. Elder Mara asks you to drive them off.

objectives.text: Tell Elder Mara the well is safe

offer: Is there anything else I can do?

nodes.speaker: Elder Mara
nodes.text: Wolves prowl around the old well. Nobody dares to fetch water.

nodes.speaker: Elder Mara
nodes.text: Two of them, at least. Be careful.

nodes.speaker: Elder Mara
nodes.text: Thank you. Take this ether for your trouble.
